title: Event envelope schemaVersion bumped to require v2
query: What breaks across repositories if the event envelope schemaVersion is bumped and v1 envelopes are rejected?

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns EventEnvelope and the inbox version gate

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: OrderConfirmedListener deduplicates by envelope eventId and reads the envelope

affected_repositories.name: basket-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: OrderConfirmedListener consumes the same envelope for basket completion

affected_repositories.name: payment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: PaymentCommandListener redacts and parses versioned command envelopes

notes: Envelope-level change: topic names stay identical while every message on them changes meaning. Tools matching on topic strings report no change at all, which is exactly wrong.
